messages:
kai: Heads-up: doing a chill Lighthouse Lounge LAN + Game Swap this Thursday. low-key, BYO rig or just come for couch co-op and snacks. anyone in? :joystick:

jules: heck yes. i'll bring my switch + a Mario Kart cart. also a box of mini donuts.

anya: i'll swap a few spare steam keys—mostly indie puzzlers. can we do a "mystery envelope" giveaway instead of hiding notes? easier for remote folks.

rob: i'm in. can host a tiny Rocket League bracket. will bring two extra controllers.

jen: i'll run sign-ups on a sheet and print a small schedule. time? 6:30/7/8pm?

poll-bot: POLL by jen — "Start time" Options: "6:30pm", "7pm", "8pm". Votes: Kai (7pm), Jules (6:30pm), Anya (7pm), Rob (7pm), Jen (7pm).

kai: 7pm it is. logistics: swap envelopes at the welcome table. label your gear. one key per person, and remote folks get two digital envelopes in a raffle.

anya: love the digital raffle idea. remote folks DM me for their raffle entry.

rob: travel-router situation: does anyone have one? last month NAT made parrying impossible.

jules: i have one. i'll bring it and a tiny how-to. quick config below:

```
# travel-router quick setup
mode router
enable dhcp
nat enable
wifi ssid "Lighthouse-LAN"
```

jen: snacks: chips/cookies/vegan bars. i'll add a signup. please label allergens.

kai: scoreboard: i'll make a tiny Google Sheet and pin link in this thread before Thursday. also planning a short rules doc for brackets.

rob: bracket note: keeping matches best-of-3 casual. sign-up only; no prior ranking.

anya: curious: can we do a tiny cos-play bonus? best silly outfit gets first pick of the mystery envelopes. :trophy:

jules: yes please. bonus: bring a prop and you get a sticker.

lobby-bot: Reminder: Lighthouse Lounge reserved 7pm-11pm. Please return chairs and wipe tables after event.

jen: final notes: one envelope per person, no taking others' gear, clean up after. see y'all Thursday :partyparrot:

kai: added the sign-up sheet: https://sheets.example.com/s/lighthouse-lan-signup — ping me if you want controllers or adapters.

anya: remote link: i'll post Parsec room on Thursday for folks to spectate and enter the raffle. good times!"
